notes:
Patch 0.1.16 (auto-patch)

Players on 0.1.15 can take this in-game: the menu checks the patch list, downloads the zip parts, then applies after a short countdown you can cancel. Mega is still for first-time installs.

Combat
- Hold right-click to block with a melee weapon: facing cuts most damage; a little still gets through.
- Higher Blocking skill blocks more of the hit (up to about 97% at skill 100).
- Blocking spends a little stamina; below 20% stamina the guard drops and the weapon leaves the block pose.
- Successful blocks still stumble the attacker and raise Blocking.
- New first-play tip covers blocking.
- Push to Talk is B (keyboard) or D-Pad Up (gamepad) — not Caps Lock, and not shared with aim/block.

Heat and desert
- Screen darkening starts near heat 96; full blackout episode triggers at 99.
- Desert heat climbs slower in the sun (sprint, campfire, and shelter still heat faster).
- Copper ore is rarer in the wild and in merchant stock.

Creatures
- Donkeys bray less often (about every half minute to a minute).

World and presentation
- Sun and moon rotate again during day/night.
- Stronger sun glare: hexagonal lens ghosts, plus a bright wash when you look straight at the sun.
- Starter rock is fist-sized when thrown or on the ground (not a boulder).
- Copper, iron, gold, and skyiron rocks stay fist-to-head size; plain stone can still roll large.
- Koosh (shoom) plants are visible at a readable size (not audio-only).
- Village fireplace sound stays muted while the loading screen is up.

Crafting and books
- Yurt recipe: 100 cloth + 25 wood.
- Credits list updated.
- Twenty ash lore books rewritten into plain speech (less riddle chains).

Settings and menu
- Settings rows and nav labels no longer clip into the wood borders.
- Long Audio hints no longer overlap the Behavior section.
- Controls list shows Push to Talk as B · D-Pad Up, and Aim / Block on RMB.
- With no internet, the update line says Offline instead of Checking for updates.
- Quitting to the main menu runs an update check again.
- Closing inventory with E keeps mouse lock for look.
